Weak Hero Class 2

약한영웅 Class 2

K-Drama · Series · South Korea · 2025

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐∞/10

Overview

Still traumatized by the events that left Su-ho in a coma, Yeon Si-eun transfers to Eunjang High School, where he meets new friends who stand beside him. However, they soon become involved in a conflict against The Union, a violent organization controlling multiple schools. While protecting his new friends, Si-eun also confronts the painful memories of his past.

My Review

Si-eun was transferred to Eunjang High School because of what happened, and it was the only school willing to accept him—a school filled with even more bullies. There, he met Jun-tae, Hyun-tak, and Park Hu-min (Baku). Jun-tae was also bullied, but Si-eun encouraged him with the words: "Do you know Newton's Third Law? For every action, there's an equal and opposite reaction." I love Baku because even though he is one of the strongest fighters, he never bullies anyone. Later, it is revealed that there is an organization called The Union, and its leader is Baku's childhood friend, Na Baek-jin. Baku was the one who taught him how to fight, which is why he later says: "I'll never teach someone to fight again." The ending was bittersweet. It was finally revealed that Su-ho woke up from his coma, although we only got a very small interaction between him and Si-eun. So bitin. I also felt really sad for Baek-jin because he died. I don't even know if it's really true because they never clearly showed how it happened. I cried when Baku mourned his childhood friend. Now I'm just waiting for Season 3.

Favorite Scene/Part

• Si-eun standing up for Jun-tae. • Their friendship (Si-eun, Jun-tae, Baku, Gotak). • Baku protecting his friends. • Every fight involving The Union. • Baku confronting Baek-jin. • Su-ho finally waking up at the end.

Favorite Quote/Lines

"For every action, there's an equal and opposite reaction."
